cards.text: I'm really into hiking. Last weekend I climbed a mountain near Alicante.
cards.tr: Я очень увлекаюсь походами. В прошлые выходные поднялся(лась) на гору под Аликанте.

cards.text: I took up running a few months ago, and now I'm totally hooked. What do you do for fun?
cards.tr: Я начал(а) бегать пару месяцев назад и теперь совсем подсел(а). А ты чем увлекаешься?

n1.say: Hey, I'm Jordan. First time at this meetup?
n1.tr: Привет, я Джордан. Первый раз на этой встрече?

choices.text: Hi Jordan, yeah, first time. A friend told me about it.

choices.feedback: Добавь деталь: Yes, a friend told me about it.

n2.say: Cool. So, what do you do for fun?

choices.text: I'm really into hiking, and I recently took up chess.
Honestly, I mostly binge-watch series and chill out.

n3.say: Nice! I got hooked on chess during the pandemic. Do you play online?
n3.tr: Класс! Я подсел(а) на шахматы в пандемию. Ты играешь онлайн?

choices.text: Yeah, mostly on my phone. We should play a game sometime.

choices.feedback: Резко, особенно если собеседник это любит 🙂

n4.say: Definitely. There's a chess night here every Thursday, actually.
n4.tr: Обязательно. Кстати, здесь каждый четверг шахматный вечер.

choices.text: Oh, I didn't know that! I'm in. What time does it start?
Sounds fun, but I'm not much of a night person. Is there anything on weekends?

n5.say: Seven o'clock. I'll save you a seat!
